Code checks are clean. The branch conflicts with main. Label: `conflicts`.

## Scope and results

This is a safety-tier review. I read the whole diff and issue #3333, including its comments. There is no earlier review.

- The orbit keeps its radius and circle vertices. Vector picks change the order of the existing directions.
- The generators keep the wear and allowance checks. The tests cover command refusals, generator refusals, stock simulation, MCP, undo and redo.
- The body has before/after screenshots for all three UI cases. I opened all six images.
- No dependency, build script, workflow, process file, importer or test fixture changed.

All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3980`. No GitHub runner ran.

The trial merge used upstream main `10ea81a2a1da2f883d43385757db802e83c99fd1`. It failed in the two files below. I aborted it without a resolution. All build and test results below apply to PR head `c2f1d36cdbd3e73da4327508cc9fe8e071e194a7`, not to a merged head. No merge commit exists, so the `HEAD^1` check does not apply.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 60 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. Tests: 2,933 passed, 37 ignored. The gate selects the PR diff from merge base `97a676e5c`.
- `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`: 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. All 11 light tests passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 32 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Both application and UI build steps (`--no-run`) passed. UI tests ran from `crates/ui`.

## Requested before merge

1. `crates/app/src/operation/pick_kinds.rs:69`: this file conflicts with current main. Refresh the branch and retain both families' pick behavior.
2. `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs:398`: the `edit_operation` schema text conflicts with current main. Refresh the text for both families.

Run the targeted checks on the refreshed head. These are merge conflicts; I found no separate code blocker on the reviewed head. The PR stays a draft while it conflicts.

## Mutations rerun by the reviewer

Each mutation ran alone. I restored the original source after each run.

| Mutation in `sinker_picks.rs` | Test | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Disable the `orbit.is_none()` refusal | `sinker_picks_orbit_ends_reads_angles_and_refuses_by_name` | Expected red: exit 101; the no-orbit pick was accepted |
| Remove the middle-of-move refusal | `sinker_picks_side_ends_choose_the_nearer_end_and_refuse_the_middle` | Expected red: exit 101; the middle pick was accepted |
| Restore the original source | All seven `sinker_picks::tests::` tests | Green: 7 passed |

The worktree has no source changes after these checks.

## Extra suites run

The quick gate ran these suites by name:

- `example_catalog`: 43 passed, 4 ignored.
- `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- Sinker golden suites: `sinker_burn`, `sinker_orbit`, `sinker_side`, `sinker_wear`, and `sinker_undersize`. All passed.
- `start_exit_shared`: 13 passed, including all nine new sinker tests.

No fixture or importer change triggers the extra kernel suites.

## Goldens moved

None. The PR diff changes no recorded `.nc`, `.cl`, or `examples/catalog` file. There are no moved golden lines to inspect. All selected sinker goldens passed without an update.

Class: DELTA. I merged `upstream/main` into the branch with a merge commit. There is no rebase and no force-push. I resolved three hunks by hand. Each hunk keeps the two sides:

1. `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs` (`s_edit_op`): the text keeps main's lathe list (#3331, Meridian kinds) and the Wire Contour start/exit text from main (#3332). The Sinker Burn and Sinker Side Burn pick text from this PR is added after the Wire Contour text.
2. `crates/app/src/operation/pick_kinds.rs` (`sane` tail): this is one `match`. It keeps `OpParams::WireContour(w) => wire_exit_refusal(w)` (#3332) and adds the `SinkerBurn` `orbit_ends()` and `SinkerSideBurn` `side_ends()` refusals (#3333). No refusal is lost. 3. `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared.rs`: the file keeps the #3330 and #3331 gate-map lines and adds the #3333 gate-map line and `mod sinker`. The capability test keeps the Meridian and Slot arms and adds the two sinker arms.

`git show --remerge-diff HEAD` shows only these three files.

Pins run on the new head:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 62 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. This includes the ui lib (`sinker_pick_rows_tests`) and the sinker app suites.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib sinker_picks`: 7 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

I merged `upstream/main` (`83d52ef6a`) into the branch. The new head is `295f8b3e9`. I did not rebase and did not force-push. I set the PR to draft again because the merge has hand edits.

[Issue #4058](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/4058) tracks this error:

```text
error[E0063]: missing field `lead_arc_radius` in initializer of `camcraft_app::operation::WireContourOp`
  --> crates/app/tests/wire_post/model_arcs.rs:42:14
```

I ran the same failed debug build, release build and all-target clippy commands on bare main `83d52ef6a`. Each failed with this error at this line. I also checked `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test wire_post --no-run` on bare main. It failed the same way.

This PR does not change that file. The inherited failure does not block this review under the user's override. The `wire_post` tests could not run. No unmodified PR test failed.
